verdict.summary: Round 1's cache-poisoning defect is resolved. On corrupt or foreign restored state, run() now completes the live sweep, replaces the unusable file with validated current observations before raising the fail-loud error, and the workflow's always() save therefore caches recoverable state. The new two-tick end-to-end test checks both that the first tick remains exit 2 and that the following tick reaches the normal alarm verdict instead of re-failing. The workflow seam also pins the shared restore/save path, rolling key family, always() guard, and main-only save. No new correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security issue is evident in the diff.
